title: Kingdom of God
definition: The kingdom of God is God's saving reign revealed in Scripture, inaugurated through Christ, present among His people, and awaiting future fullness.
summary: God reigns, and His kingdom is revealed through Christ's rule and saving work.
christFocus: Jesus came proclaiming the kingdom, reigns as King, and will bring the kingdom to final fullness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The kingdom of God is the reign of God. It is not merely a place, political movement, or human program. It is God's saving rule breaking into history through Christ.

Jesus announced the kingdom, demonstrated its power, taught its values, and secured its citizens through His death and resurrection.

The kingdom is already present in Christ's reign and among His people, yet it awaits final public fullness when Christ returns.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people reduce Christianity to private belief or political power. The kingdom of God matters because it centers hope and obedience in God's reign through Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Seek first God's kingdom. Live under Christ's rule now through repentance, righteousness, mercy, mission, and hope for His return.
